title: Bus with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body: bright yellow -->
  <rect x='12' y='28' width='76' height='46' rx='8' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- Roof highlight -->
  <rect x='16' y='31' width='68' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <!-- Front windshield: light blue -->
  <rect x='58' y='36' width='26' height='20' rx='4' fill='#8FD8F0'/>
  <!-- Side windows: light blue, different shade -->
  <rect x='18' y='36' width='16' height='20' rx='3' fill='#6FC4E8'/>
  <rect x='38' y='36' width='16' height='20' rx='3' fill='#6FC4E8'/>
  <!-- Window shine -->
  <rect x='61' y='39' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#D6F3FF'/>
  <rect x='21' y='39' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#D6F3FF'/>
  <!-- Smile: dark lit red-orange? use warm glow color for smile -->
  <path d='M28 66 Q 44 78 60 66' stroke='#FF6B3D' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes: small black-like lit purple -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='4' fill='#5A3B8C'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='4' fill='#5A3B8C'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='56.5' r='1.4' fill='#D8C9FF'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='56.5' r='1.4' fill='#D8C9FF'/>
  <!-- Bumper: orange -->
  <rect x='12' y='72' width='76' height='6' rx='3' fill='#F08A24'/>
  <!-- Headlights: pale yellow glow -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='70' r='4' fill='#FFF2A8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='70' r='4' fill='#FFF2A8'/>
  <!-- Wheels: deep grey-purple with lighter hubs -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='78' r='7' fill='#4A4458'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='78' r='3' fill='#B0A8C0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='7' fill='#4A4458'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='3' fill='#B0A8C0'/>
  <!-- Cheeks: soft pink -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='63' r='3.5' fill='#FFB3B3'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='63' r='3.5' fill='#FFB3B3'/>
</svg>
